# Loading in OpenAI Codex

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lumitive/lumi-style ~/src/lumi-style
ln -s ~/src/lumi-style ~/.codex/skills/lumi-style
```

Invoke: Codex reads AGENTS.md from the project root by convention; the skill path is read directly.

The skill reads `references/` and `tokens/` on demand — no need to attach them manually.

**Symlink rather than copy.** An installed copy silently stranded at 0.1.334 while the repo reached 0.1.337, and a deck was built against three versions of superseded rules. A symlink cannot go stale.

Codex also reads `AGENTS.md` from the project root by convention, so a checkout in the working tree is picked up without any install.

Vendor documentation: https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills/
